_doc: Research-answer benchmark for deep search: Moonlit's 5 questions (Dutch text exactly as sent on 2026-10-10). 'reference' lists what Moonlit Luna found (competitor research/moonlit-raw/2026-10-10-5-questions.md). It is a REFERENCE, not gold: nothing was verified independently, and Moonlit's own claim check flagged some of it. 'gaps' are things Moonlit said it could not find; an honest 'not found' there is a correct answer unless a source proves otherwise. Score with rubric.md.

questions.question: Welke besluiten en boetes heeft de ACM opgelegd aan webshops voor misleidende kortingen, nep-afteltimers of andere dark patterns? Noem per zaak het bedrijf, jaar en de geschonden bepaling.
reference: 2024 fake-discount fines: Day Traders/Koopjedeal EUR 163,000; Leen Bakker EUR 130,000; G-Star EUR 110,000; JYSK EUR 112,500; Tommy Hilfiger EUR 105,500
Koopjedeal breached art. 2b lid 2 Prijzenwet jo. art. 5a lid 1 Besluit prijsaanduiding producten (research found the same in the JYSK PDF, plus art. 2.9 Whc)
Court confirmed the Leen Bakker and Koopjedeal fines (ACM press release 13 Nov 2025)

Epic Games (Fortnite), decision 18 Dec 2023: EUR 562,500 for misleading timers (art. 8.8 Whc jo. 6:193g onder g BW), EUR 562,500 for direct exhortation to children (art. 8.8 Whc jo. 6:193i onder e BW), binding instruction on Item Shop dark pattern (6:193b lid 2 BW); objection unfounded 27 Nov 2024
TrendX 2022: EUR 100,000 for fake reviews and unclear delivery times
Vodafone 2019: EUR 1,159,000 (6:193d jo. 6:193e onder c BW) and EUR 1,961,500 (6:193c lid 1 onder d BW), both jo. art. 8.8 Whc
Countdown timers 2023: dozens of webshops addressed, no fines, no names
gaps: ECLI of the court ruling on Leen Bakker/Koopjedeal not found by Moonlit

questions.question: Wat zegt de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens over tracking cookies en cookiewalls, en welke boetes heeft de AP hiervoor opgelegd? Hoe verhoudt zich dat tot art. 11.7a Telecommunicatiewet?
reference: Tracking cookies need prior consent; cookie walls not allowed; pre-ticked boxes or 'by continuing you agree' are not valid consent
Kruidvat (A.S. Watson): EUR 600,000 for art. 6 lid 1 jo. 5 lid 1 onder a AVG, lowered to EUR 50,000 on objection; primary decision dated 2 or 3 May 2024 (sources differ)
Coolblue: fine for art. 5 lid 1 jo. 6 lid 1 AVG, set at EUR 40,000 on objection
Art. 11.7a Tw requires information and consent 'onverminderd de AVG'; ACM supervises 11.7a, AP supervises the AVG; for tracking cookies the regulators agreed AP takes the lead
Only enforcement on 11.7a itself found: ACM order subject to penalty against NPO (2014)

questions.question: Vanaf wanneer valt achteraf betalen (BNPL) onder AFM-toezicht door de herziene Consumentenkredietrichtlijn (CCD2), en wat is de status van de Nederlandse implementatiewet? Zijn er Kifid-uitspraken over achteraf betalen of incassokosten?
reference: BNPL falls under the Wft from 20 Nov 2026; licence under art. 2:60 Wft

Bill 36924: submitted 2 Apr 2026, nota n.a.v. verslag 23 Jun, wetgevingsoverleg 28 Sep, amended bill to the Eerste Kamer 6 Oct 2026; adoption not established. MvT says entry into force 26 Nov 2026, Kamerbrief says 20 Nov 2026
HR 26 May 2023, ECLI:NL:HR:2023:778 and HR 27 Jun 2025, ECLI:NL:HR:2025:1008 (art. 7:58 lid 2 onder e BW)
Kifid 2026-0304 and 2026-0305 (Klarna): credit agreement annulled under art. 3:40 lid 2 BW for not meeting art. 7:60/7:61 BW
Kifid 2026-0861 and 2026-0953 (Klarna): complaint not admissible, exemption art. 1:20 lid 1 onder e Wft (old)

questions.question: Wat zijn de regels van de Reclamecode voor influencers die onze achteraf-betaaldienst promoten, met voorbeelden van RCC-uitspraken? En heeft het College voor de Rechten van de Mens geoordeeld over discriminatie door algoritmische kredietchecks of risicoprofilering?
reference: RSM art. 3 onder a en b (disclose advertising and relevant relationship), art. 6 (advertiser duty of care); examples: Tylko 2026, Fanatec 2019, Gentle Skincare 2024, Basic-Fit 2026
Credit advertising: missing 'Let op! Geld lenen kost geld' breaches art. 2 NRC; BNPL without mentioning a credit check breaches art. 7 NRC
College: Santander 2019-2 (indirect distinction on nationality); ING 2024-62/2024-63 (race), 2024-100 (nationality), 2026-78 (justified); Breeze 2023-82; test under art. 1 Awgb
gaps: No RCC ruling on influencers promoting BNPL
No College ruling on algorithmic credit checks specifically

questions.question: Welke btw-regels gelden voor onze verkopen aan consumenten in andere EU-landen (OSS), en zijn er standpunten van de Belastingdienst-kennisgroepen of rechtspraak over het btw-moment bij achteraf betalen?
reference: Distance sales taxed where goods arrive (art. 5a lid 1 onder a Wet OB); EUR 10,000 threshold (art. 6k Wet OB)
OSS (Unieregeling): quarterly electronic return, also in quarters without sales
VAT moment (art. 13 Wet OB): at invoice if invoicing is required, otherwise at delivery or payment; due at the latest one year after the payment fell due; transfer of receivables to a BNPL provider
A-G opinion 26 Jun 2014, ECLI:NL:PHR:2014:688
gaps: No kennisgroep position or case law on the VAT moment for BNPL
